 The Shipping team is responsible for providing our buyers and sellers with a first\-class shipping experience. We connect a global community of musicians, providing buyers with competitive prices, equipping sellers with the tools they need to optimize their shipping, and protecting both buyers and sellers throughout the entire process. It’s a crucial part of shopping on Reverb, and the team is dedicated to every aspect of it.
   

  

 We're looking for a full\-stack engineer to join our team. You'll work across our Rails app, React frontend, and GraphQL gateway, touching every piece of the shipping experience from buyer\-facing UIs to seller configuration tools to vendor integrations. You'll collaborate closely with other full\-stack and mobile engineers, product, and design to deliver the shipping features that make Reverb the best place to buy and sell gear.

* Take ownership of the health and performance of your team's services, not just the work you ship

* 2\-4\+ years of professional software engineering experience
* Solid fundamentals in Ruby/Rails and JavaScript/React and comfort working across the stack
* Familiarity with GraphQL or eagerness to learn it
* Understanding of web architecture including the separation of frontend and backend concerns and thoughtful API design
* Clear communicator who can scope and explain tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and designers alike
* Experience with AI workflows, TypeScript, Datadog, Docker, Kubernetes, and GitHub Actions is a plus
